summary_en: ¥3.0B upper limit (expanded from ¥2.7B), 1,000,000 shares (3.33% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), market purchase window May 15, 2026 – Mar 31, 2027. Reason: to execute flexible share buybacks in light of stock price and financial position. No shares acquired as of July 29, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Partial Revision of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Expansion of Acquisition Limit)
translation_en_brief: On July 30, 2026, Sekisui Jushi's board of directors amended the treasury stock acquisition framework initially approved on May 13, 2026. The company expanded the authorized acquisition limit from ¥2.7 billion to ¥3.0 billion, while retaining the share count ceiling of 1,000,000 shares (3.33% of outstanding shares excluding treasury). The acquisition window remains May 15, 2026 through March 31, 2027, using open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of July 29, 2026, no shares had been acquired under the program. The company stated the expansion reflects market price conditions and financial position, enabling more flexible execution. The company's policy caps treasury holdings at approximately 5% of issued shares; amounts exceeding that threshold are to be cancelled. Total shareholder returns (dividends plus buybacks) are targeted at 100% or above through the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
